name: OpenRouter chat/completions
cadence: on demand (bench runs, not a standing monitor)
notes: Public catalog at /api/v1/models (464 ids, no key needed). Key is NOT in the DSH session env: it lives in the dsh web server process environ (scan /proc/*/environ, match OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-). Responses include usage.cost, so per-run spend is auditable. Pricing is per-token and varies ~3 orders of magnitude across ids (luna 0.10/0.50 per M vs astra 10/50) - always price a cohort before running it. Model ids rotate; re-check the catalog rather than assuming an id exists.
